title: Covey agent card
description: What an agent publishes about itself. Stored whole by the daemon and returned by discovery. Breaking changes bump the `covey` major version.

slug.description: Human-chosen name, unique per node. `human` is reserved for the human pseudo-agent.

kind.description: What sort of agent this is, e.g. `claude-code`, `openclaw`, `python`, `human`. Free text so new kinds are not a breaking change.

workdir.description: Absolute path the agent works in, if it has one.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what this agent knows and owns. Discovery ranks against it.

instructions.description: Optional free text for peers: how to phrase requests, what this agent will not do.

delivery.description: How the daemon gets a request in front of this agent.

webhook_url.description: Called on new requests. Required when delivery is `webhook`.

wakeable.description: Whether the daemon may spawn a headless worker for this agent when no session is attached.

worker.description: How a headless worker runs for this agent when it is wakeable and has no session. Set only by the human through `covey agent add`; an agent cannot change it. Omitted fields take the defaults shown.

allowed_tools.description: Claude Code tools the worker may use, besides the covey tools the daemon always adds.

max_turns.description: Turn cap for one worker run.

max_budget_usd.description: Spend cap in US dollars for one worker run.

daily_spawns.description: Most workers started for this agent in any rolling 24 hours.

public_key.description: Reserved for signed identities in v2. Always null in v1.

name.description: Capability name, e.g. `explain`, `run_tests`. `*` is not allowed in a card; wildcards exist only in grants.
